name: The Binding of Isaac: Sacrilege
summary: The Binding of Isaac: Sacrilege is a 45-track anthology four years in the making. Designed to fulfill the community's yearning for an expansion of Danny Baranowsky's iconic Wrath of the Lamb score, Sacrilege utilizes the same songwriting methods and vintage toolsets to bridge the soundscape gap left by Rebirth and Repentance. Including Danny's original soundtrack, this faithful return to the title's musical roots offers a familiar yet uncanny similarity to his iconic style while introducing a refreshing new sonic palette.
